Disappointing and not 4,5
Jan 2026 • Couples
Food mediocre, spring roll wrap was not soft, friend chicken drumsticks no taste and hard, we didn’t pursue and left. Same owners as cuccina which is better.
Written January 11, 2026
Cucina Sapa
Dear BkCanada,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are truly sorry to hear that your experience at Anise Sapa Restaurant did not meet your expectations.

Your comments regarding the spring roll wrap and the fried chicken drumsticks are taken seriously. This is certainly not the standard we aim to deliver, and we regret that the dishes you received were not as they should have been. We also wish you had informed our team during your visit, as we would have gladly replaced the dishes or offered an alternative immediately.

While Anise and Cucina are under the same ownership, each restaurant has its own concept, kitchen team, and menu. That said, we fully agree that consistency and quality across all our venues are essential, and your feedback helps us identify areas that need improvement.

We sincerely appreciate your honesty and will use your comments to review our preparation and service processes. Should you consider giving us another chance in the future, we would be very happy to welcome you back and provide a much better experience.

Best regards,

Owner – Anise Sapa Restaurant

We are happy to share that our team will take this feedback into consideration and offer this sauce option more proactively to guests who order Haxen in the future.

Thank you again for your thoughtful advice and for dining with us at Anise Sapa Restaurant. We hope to welcome you back again soon.

Lovely little hidden gem
Jun 2025 • Couples
This little gem is hidden away from the main strip, it is a short walk up a stone stair case aisle where you can find this lovely little restaurant.

This is our second visit for dinner having previously enjoyed their meals.

Tonight we shared an amazing roasted pork knuckle, it was and experience with the waitress carving it up for us and then being served.

The taste matched the experience. Amazing!

Dear Valued Guest,
Thank you so much for calling us your ‘lovely little hidden gem’ – it truly warms our hearts! We’re delighted that you found our tucked-away spot and enjoyed the peaceful ambiance away from the main strip.

Knowing you chose to return for a second dinner is the highest compliment we could receive. We’re thrilled you loved the roasted pork knuckle experience! Our team takes great pride in presenting it tableside – it’s not just a dish, but a little tradition we love sharing with guests like you.

Your kind words about the service and meal mean everything to us. We’d be honored to welcome you back for a third visit soon – perhaps with another signature dish to surprise you!

With sincere gratitude,

Anise Trinh - Owner of the Anise Sapa
